rows.note: This is the casual default when something can simply be left out or done without.

example.english: This step is dispensable; it doesn't affect the result.
example.traditional: 呢個步驟唔要都得，唔影響個結果。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 bou6 zau6 m4 jiu3 dou1 dak1 m4 jing2 hoeng2 go3 git3 gwo2

rows.note: Use this when describing something as optional, nonessential, or readily replaceable in a more general way.

example.english: To the company, this benefit is dispensable.
example.traditional: 對公司嚟講，呢項福利可有可無。
example.jyutping: deoi3 gung1 si1 lei4 gong2 ni1 hong6 fuk1 lei6 ho2 jau5 ho2 mou4
